entry.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
entry.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

entry.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
entry.summary: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

entry.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
entry.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

entry.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
entry.summary: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.

entry.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
entry.summary: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

entry.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
entry.summary: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

entry.title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
entry.summary: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.

entry.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
entry.summary: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

entry.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
entry.summary: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

entry.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
entry.summary: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

entry.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
entry.summary: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

entry.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
entry.summary: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

entry.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
entry.summary: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

entry.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
entry.summary: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

entry.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
entry.summary: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

entry.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
entry.summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

entry.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
entry.summary: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

entry.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia
entry.summary: The company plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.

entry.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
entry.summary: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.

entry.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
entry.summary: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.
